query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) AS total_examiners,
  SUM(is_fictitious_example) AS fictitious_examples,
  SUM(CASE WHEN is_fictitious_example = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS real_accounts
FROM users WHERE role = 'examiner';
